title: Budget dial derived from context; ask only on anomalies
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. SUSI_BUDGET defaults to balanced and moves to low automatically for free-tier keys or a spend spike; ask the human only when a cap would be crossed. Tests zc_budget_derived_*.
